plan: To improve win rate, we will (1) implement a stricter entry filter: require relative volume >1.5x and price >VWAP, (2) add an RSI <70 filter during risk‑off periods, (3) limit to 2 trades per day to reduce over‑trading, (4) use a 1% trailing stop after first target, (5) backtest these rules on last 30 days to confirm PF >1.2. Once validated, we will re‑enable trading with these filters.
